docs.description: Replaces the 2023 leave rules. Changes casual, earned and medical leave entitlements and moves applications to the ERP.
docs.title: Revised Leave Rules for Teaching and Non-Teaching Staff 2026

versions.note: Corrected effective date on page 2 (typo in OCR text)

pages.text: Subject: Revised Leave Rules for Teaching and Non-Teaching Staff, effective 1 August 2026.

In supersession of Notification No. SVSU/REG/HR/2023/045 dated 12 April 2023, the competent authority has approved the following revised leave rules for all regular employees of the University and its constituent colleges.
1. Casual Leave: Every regular employee is entitled to 12 days of casual leave in a calendar year. Casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next year.
2. Casual leave may not be combined with earned leave or any other leave, except special casual leave sanctioned by the Registrar.

3. Earned Leave: Non-vacation staff shall earn 30 days of earned leave per year, credited in two half-yearly instalments of 15 days on 1 January and 1 July. Teaching staff availing summer and winter vacation shall earn 10 days per year.

4. Medical Leave: An employee may avail up to 10 days of medical leave per year. Medical leave exceeding 3 consecutive days requires a certificate from a registered medical practitioner, preferably from Subharti Hospital.

5. All leave applications must be submitted through the University ERP at least 3 working days in advance, except in cases of emergency or illness, which must be regularised within 2 working days of resuming duty.
6. Leave of teaching staff during the examination period requires prior approval of the Controller of Examinations in addition to the Head of Department.
7. Earned leave can be accumulated up to a maximum of 180 days.
These rules come into force from 1 August 2026. All Heads of Institutions are requested to bring this notification to the notice of all employees.

docs.description: Historical record. Superseded by the Revised Leave Rules 2026 from 1 August 2026.
docs.title: Leave Rules for University Employees 2023

pages.text: Subject: Leave Rules for University Employees.
1. Casual Leave: Every regular employee is entitled to 10 days of casual leave in a calendar year.
2. Earned Leave: Non-vacation staff shall earn 15 days of earned leave per year. Teaching staff availing vacation shall earn 8 days per year.
3. Medical Leave: Up to 10 days of medical leave per year may be availed. A medical certificate is required for leave exceeding 2 consecutive days.
4. Leave applications shall be submitted in the prescribed paper format to the Head of Department at least 2 days in advance.
5. Earned leave can be accumulated up to a maximum of 120 days.

docs.description: Office hours, grace period, late-arrival deductions and biometric re-enrolment.
docs.title: Biometric Attendance and Office Timings

pages.text: Subject: Biometric Attendance and Office Timings for Employees.
1. Office hours for all employees are 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM, Monday to Saturday, except second and fourth Saturdays.
2. A grace period of 15 minutes is permitted. Arrival after 9:15 AM shall be marked as late.
3. Three late arrivals in a calendar month shall result in deduction of half a day of casual leave. If no casual leave is available, the deduction shall be made from salary.
4. Employees must mark attendance at both arrival and departure. A missing punch must be regularised by the Head of Department through the ERP within 3 working days.
5. All employees whose fingerprint registration is older than 2 years must re-enrol at the IT Cell, Room 104, Administrative Block, by 15 October 2026.

docs.description: Practical and theory exam dates, admit cards and internal marks deadline.
docs.title: Schedule of Odd Semester End-Term Examinations, Nov–Dec 2026

pages.text: Subject: Schedule of Odd Semester End-Term Examinations, November–December 2026.
1. Practical examinations for all undergraduate and postgraduate programmes shall be conducted from 9 November 2026 to 20 November 2026 at the respective colleges.
2. Theory end-term examinations shall commence on 23 November 2026 and conclude on 12 December 2026. The detailed date sheet will be available on the University website.
3. Admit cards can be downloaded from the student ERP from 16 November 2026. Students with outstanding fee dues will not be issued admit cards.

4. Heads of Departments shall ensure that internal assessment marks are uploaded on the examination portal by 31 October 2026. Marks will not be accepted after this date without approval of the Controller of Examinations.
5. Faculty members assigned invigilation duty shall follow the guidelines issued separately by the Examination Cell.

docs.title: परीक्षा ड्यूटी हेतु दिशा-निर्देश (Invigilation Duty Guidelines)

pages.text: विषय: विषम सेमेस्टर परीक्षा 2026 में कक्ष निरीक्षक ड्यूटी हेतु दिशा-निर्देश।
1. सभी कक्ष निरीक्षक परीक्षा प्रारम्भ होने से 45 मिनट पूर्व परीक्षा केन्द्र पर रिपोर्ट करेंगे।
2. परीक्षा कक्ष में कक्ष निरीक्षकों द्वारा मोबाइल फोन का प्रयोग पूर्णतः प्रतिबंधित है। मोबाइल फोन केन्द्र अधीक्षक के पास जमा कराने होंगे।
3. ड्यूटी में परिवर्तन केवल परीक्षा नियंत्रक की लिखित अनुमति से ही किया जा सकेगा।
4. ड्यूटी हेतु सहमति पत्र 20 अक्टूबर 2026 तक परीक्षा प्रकोष्ठ में जमा करना अनिवार्य है।
5. अनुचित साधनों के प्रयोग की स्थिति में कक्ष निरीक्षक तत्काल केन्द्र अधीक्षक को सूचित करेंगे तथा निर्धारित प्रपत्र में रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत करेंगे।

docs.description: Instalment due dates, late fine and payment counters.
docs.title: Fee Payment Schedule, Session 2026–27

pages.text: Subject: Fee Payment Schedule for Academic Session 2026–27.
1. The first instalment of tuition fee was payable at the time of admission or re-registration.
2. The second instalment of tuition fee for all programmes shall be paid by 31 October 2026.
3. A late fine of ₹100 per day shall be charged after the due date, subject to a maximum of ₹5,000.
4. Fees can be paid online through the student ERP or at the Accounts counter, Administrative Block, between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM.
5. Students who do not clear dues before examinations will not be issued admit cards.

docs.title: Extension of Last Date for Second Instalment Fee

pages.text: Subject: Extension in last date for payment of second instalment fee.
In view of requests received from students and parents, the last date for payment of the second instalment fee for session 2026–27 is extended to 7 November 2026 without late fine.

Students whose post-matric scholarship applications are under verification may pay the second instalment by 30 November 2026 on submission of the scholarship acknowledgement slip at the Accounts counter.
This circular is issued with the approval of the Finance Officer.

docs.description: Portal deadline, hard-copy submission and bank seeding advice.
docs.title: U.P. Post-Matric Scholarship 2026–27: Online Application

pages.text: Subject: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship 2026–27 — online application.
Eligible students must complete the online application on the State scholarship portal by 10 November 2026.

A printed copy of the submitted form, along with income certificate, category certificate (where applicable), previous year mark sheet and fee receipt, must be submitted to the Scholarship Section, Student Welfare Office, by 17 November 2026.
Applications with mismatched Aadhaar-linked bank details will be rejected by the portal. Students are advised to verify bank seeding before applying.

docs.description: Email use, password rotation, USB restrictions and incident reporting.
docs.title: Acceptable Use of IT Resources and Official Email

pages.text: Subject: Acceptable Use of IT Resources and Official Email.
1. Official communication must be sent only from the employee’s University email account. Personal email accounts must not be used for official records.
2. Passwords for the ERP and email must be changed every 90 days and must not be shared with any other person.
3. Personal USB storage devices may not be connected to computers in the Examination Cell and Accounts Department.
4. Loss of a University laptop or any suspected security incident must be reported to the IT Cell within 24 hours.

docs.description: Document verification deadline and return of originals.
docs.title: Guidelines for Provisional Admission, Session 2026–27

pages.text: Subject: Guidelines for Provisional Admission, Session 2026–27.
Provisionally admitted students must complete document verification at the Admission Cell by 30 September 2026.
Admission of students who fail to complete document verification within the stipulated time is liable to be cancelled without further notice.
Original documents will be returned on the same day after verification. The University does not retain original certificates.
